text:
Maya: Heads up — the kettle in kitchen A is now opening for requests. It only heats when you hum 'My Heart Will Go On'. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
Omar: Noted. I brought my own thermal mug. Will test at 3pm :mag_right:
Sora: Wait that's not a feature, that's a cult. :joy:
Lina: @Maya pls stop serenading appliances in the middle of standup :stuck_out_tongue:
Ben: Whoever coded the kettle clearly had a soft spot for ballads. Also can we add 'kettle +1' to the onboarding checklist? :thumbsup:
Maya: Fine. For the record, it also accepts bribes (cookies). Observed pattern:
```
if cookie > 0:
  kettle.whistle('Celine')
```
Omar: I will sacrifice a biscotti tomorrow. Report back.
devops-bot: Reminder: kitchen-thermals channel scheduled cleanup at 17:00. :robot_face:
Sora: Quick poll: who wants a tiny sticker that says 'Kettle Whisperer'? React with :raised_hands:
Lina: :raised_hands: (for team morale)
Ben: :point_up_2: (for sticker economy)
Maya: micro-kudo to @Omar for bringing biscotti bravery. :star2:
kudos-bot: kudos recorded: Maya -> Omar: 'Biscotti bravery' :tada:
